title: Find the Kth Element in Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays `nums1` and `nums2` of sizes `m` and `n` respectively, find the `k`th smallest element of the combined sorted array in O(log(m + n)) time.
input_format: First line contains `m`, `n`, and `k`. Second line has `nums1`. Third line has `nums2`.
hints: Divide and conquer on k: compare nums1[k//2] and nums2[k//2].
Discard k//2 elements from the array with smaller element.
Recurse with updated k until k == 1.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    m, n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1]), int(data[2])
    nums1 = [int(x) for x in data[3:3+m]]
    nums2 = [int(x) for x in data[3+m:3+m+n]]
    merged = sorted(nums1 + nums2)
    print(merged[k-1])
